sources.entry: Snikket - All-in-one Dockerized easy XMPP solution, including web admin and clients. (Source Code, Clients) Apache-2.0 Docker
Snikket | Easy-to-run XMPP messaging server for families and groups

summary.one_liner: Source repository for building the Docker images of Snikket, a self-hosted XMPP-based personal messaging service.
summary.what_it_does: This repository contains the source for building Snikket server Docker images. Snikket is described as an open-source, self-hosted personal messaging service intended as an alternative to proprietary, centralized messaging platforms. The README says it aims to support the expected messaging features while being easy to use. Building is done with GNU make, which the README says is run as `make`. For running, the README recommends docker-compose: copy `snikket.conf.example` to `snikket.conf`, edit the values, then start with `docker compose up -d`. Installation instructions for end users are kept on the Snikket website rather than in this README.
use_cases: self-host a family or group messaging server
run an XMPP messaging service with docker compose
private chat server for a small group
how_to_run: Install GNU make, docker, and ansible (see README requirements)
Copy snikket.conf.example to snikket.conf and edit the values
notable: Packaged as Docker images with a docker-compose setup
Built with make and Ansible playbooks
Positioned as an all-in-one self-hosted messaging service for families and groups (per directory listing)
caveats: README is brief and defers installation details to the external Snikket website
Build requirements list tested versions (docker 19.03.5, ansible 2.7) that may be outdated
